name.description: Name of the folder the results of the run will output into

encoder.description: Encoder Network. Can be either a string or a class that inherits from BaseFeaturesExtractor. Defaults to 'small'

policy.description: Policy Network. Can be either a string or a class that inherits from BasePolicy. Defaults to 'CnnPolicy'

algorithm.description: Optimization Algorithm. Can be either a string or a class that inherits from BaseAlgorithm. Defaults to 'PPO'

reward.description: Reward Function. Can be either a string or a class that inherits from rllte BaseReward. Defaults to 'closeness'

embedding_dim.description: Embedding Dimension. Defaults to null. If null, the embedding dimension is the default for the particular encoder.

checkpoint_freq.description: Frequency of saving checkpoints. If null, no checkpoints are saved. Defaults to null.

custom_encoder_args.description: Custom Encoder Arguments that are fed directly into the encoder network

custom_algorithm_args.description: Custom Algorithm Arguments that are fed directly into the optimization algorithm

custom_policy_arch.description: An array of integers defining the number of neurons in each layer of the policy network. If not provided, the default architecture is used as defined by Stable Baselines 3.

reward_args.description: Arguments passed on to the reward function

deterministic.description: Whether to use deterministic actions during testing. Defaults to true.

custom_policy_args.description: Custom Policy Arguments that are fed directly into the policy network

continual_learning.description: Whether to use continual learning during the test phase. Defaults to false.

wrappers.description: List of wrappers to apply to the body. Can be either a string or an object that inherits from gym.Wrapper.

record_eps.description: Episodes to record from the body. Format is 'start:stop:step'.

train.description: Training episodes to record. Format is 'start:stop:step'. Defaults to '0:0:1'.

test.description: Testing episodes to record. Format is 'start:stop:step'. Defaults to '0:0:1'.

panini_projection.description: Apply a panini projection to the agent's vision

input_resolution.description: Resolution of the input images. Defaults to None. If None, the environment's default resolution is used.

binocular_vision.description: Whether the body has binocular vision. If the 'binocular' or 'multiobs' wrapper is included, this will be overridden to `True`. This is useful for implementing custom wrappers that use binocular vision. Defaults to `False`.

record_eps.description: Number of episodes to record of the environment (top-down view).

train.description: Number of training episodes to record. Defaults to 0.

test.description: Number of testing episodes to record. Defaults to 0.

multiagent.description: Whether the environment supports multi-agent training

random_first_frame.description: Whether to randomize the first frame of episodes. Defaults to false.

display.description: Display number to output to. Set to null to run headless. Defaults to null.

FOV.description: Field of View of the agent in degrees. Defaults to null. If null, the environment's default FOV is used.

continuous_position.description: Whether to use continuous position in the environment. Defaults to false.

switch_steps.description: Number of steps between object switches. Passed as --switch-steps to the Unity executable. Defaults to null.

episodes.description: Number of episodes to run for train and test

num_brains.description: Number of brains to run in parallel. Defaults to 1.

brain_id_offset.description: Offset applied to all brain IDs. Brain IDs will be 1+offset…num_brains+offset. Defaults to 0.

task_memory.description: Memory limit for a single task

eval_freq.description: Run a test evaluation every eval_freq training episodes. If null, no evaluation is performed during training. Defaults to null.
